ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominant (approx. 90-95% black/dark grey) with localized high-intensity pixel clusters (approx. 5-10% white/light grey) associated with scarring and calcification.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigment base across entire visible surface; high-contrast white circular rings (scars) scattered globally; high-intensity white linear clusters concentrated on the right lobe near the median notch; extreme high-intensity clusters at both distal tips representing external growths.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; vertex is sharp with a calculated angle of approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged; right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, low-frequency peaks (coarse serration); left lobe exhibits lower-amplitude, high-frequency serration; extreme pixel irregularity and protrusion at the right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in upwardly sweeping distal tips; the right lobe displays a more pronounced terminal protrusion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular white pixel rings (diameter range 5-15 pixels) distributed across both lobes, with a specific cluster of approximately 12-15 rosettes on the left mid-lobe region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear scratches; prominent multi-directional rake marks on the right lobe near the notch; several long, horizontal abrasions across the mid-span of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified or biological growth (barnacle clusters) at both fluke tips; large V-shaped white scar formation located on the right lobe inner margin near the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits a unique, highly textured and bulbous profile significantly different from the smoother geometric taper of the left tip.
